title: Their favorite item was the box...
text:
We currently have 5 adult cats and 7 kittens (only 1 over 6 months of age) under the roof at the moment.

Looks like this box's theme was "adult stuff." Wine treat, whiskey bottle toy, martini glass toy, cigar bunny kicker toy, romance "novel" toy, suitcase toy, and candy themed wand toy.

The cardboard box absorbed all of the catnip as it's the only item the adults showed interest in. Or it could just be that it's a perfect sized box for most of the adult cats and there wasn't really any strong catnip to begin with. 🤷🏼‍♀️

The replacement kitty wine leaked in the box during shipping. None of the catnip kitties liked the wine. The venison liver treats that were supposed to be included would have gone over well with the foster kittens and possibly some of the adults.

The wand toy is loved by the kittens and a couple of the adult cats. However, I can buy these types of wands for only $2 all year round.

We have 2 resident bunny kicker kitties and neither of them like the cigar toy.

The kittens are too young to be affected by catnip, but they are the only ones enjoying these overpriced toys. One of the foster kittens carries the luggage toy around in his mouth by the handle but I've never been able to get a picture of that adorableness! That uncaptured cuteness is what bumps this box to a solid 2 stars.

Maybe July just wasn't the best month for me to try out. 🤷🏼‍♀️ I probably should've waited until October.
label: negative
